title: Spyglass: Now Live!
summary: We're excited to announce the official launch of the Spyglass tool, moving out of beta and delivering powerful new capabilities to enhance your experience.

title: Dynamic File Management for Enhanced Content
summary: Take full command of your content with new, intuitive file management tools that let you easily upload, organize, and customize the display of images and media directly within the editor.

title: Introducing the Noeko Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap to effortlessly track past achievements, current priorities, and exciting future plans for Noeko, all in one transparent place.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: We've made your task management simpler and more enjoyable with checkboxes that are now effortlessly clickable, easily draggable, and beautifully integrated into your workspace.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Tools
summary: We've upgraded our collaboration experience, making it easier and more intuitive to work with others in real-time.

title: Enhanced Shared Items: Seamless Discovery and Collaboration
summary: We've made it easier than ever to discover and utilize content shared with you, fostering seamless collaboration and boosting productivity.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're open-sourcing Noeko to empower our community with greater transparency, control, and direct participation in the project's evolution.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We're thrilled to introduce comprehensive support for numerous international languages, allowing even more users worldwide to experience Noeko in their native tongue.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Enhanced Themes
summary: We're refining our current themes and adding a vibrant collection of new styles to give you a more personalized and visually stunning experience.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Transform your Constellation view into a dynamic hub for knowledge exploration, featuring intuitive filters for tags and time, and clear visibility into your shared content and connections.

title: Refined Search & Curated Collections
summary: Navigate your knowledge with unparalleled precision by utilizing powerful new filtering and sorting capabilities, then save your custom results as curated collections for instant access to relevant information.

title: Dynamic Note Views for Deeper Connections
summary: Experience a more intuitive way to structure your thoughts with dynamic new display modes and enhanced interactivity for all your connected notes.

title: Experience Noeko Your Way: Self-Hosted and Premium Editions
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your data and infrastructure with Noeko's new self-hosting option, and unlock advanced features through our flexible premium plans.

title: Enhanced Time-Specific Welcome Messages
summary: Enjoy a perfectly timed greeting every time you visit, as we enhance our welcome messages to accurately reflect your current time of day.

title: Effortless Tag Cleanup
summary: Take control of your content organization by effortlessly removing multiple items from any tag directly within its view.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Soon, you'll be able to seamlessly bring in and manage all your essential information, including videos, web pages, and plain text, to enrich your knowledge base.
